info.title: Task Tracker API
info.description: Reference implementation of Vertical Slice Architecture in .NET 10 Minimal APIs.

put.description: Assigns or unassigns a task. Assigned user must be a member of the containing project. Requires Editor role.

post.description: Transitions a task to a new status according to state machine rules. Requires Editor role.
Creates a new task within a project. Requires Editor or Owner role.

get.description: Returns keyset paginated tasks in a project with optional full-text search, label filtering, status, priority, and date range filters.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a task. Requires Project Owner role.

get.description: Retrieves detailed task information with weak ETag conditional caching. Requires Viewer role.

put.description: Updates task details. Requires Editor role and matching If-Match header.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted task. Requires admin authority with tasks.admin scope.
Archives a project, making it read-only for subsequent mutations. Requires Owner role.
Creates a new project workspace. The caller automatically becomes an Owner.

get.description: Returns keyset paginated projects accessible to the current user. First page is cached in HybridCache.
Retrieves project details by ID with weak ETag conditional caching.

put.description: Updates project details. Requires Owner role and matching If-Match header.

get.description: Retrieves aggregated task metrics and priority distribution for a project. Cached in HybridCache.

post.description: Restores an archived project to active status. Requires Owner role.
Adds a new member to the project with an assigned role. Requires Owner role.

get.description: Retrieves all members associated with a project. Requires Viewer role.

delete.description: Removes a user from the project. Permitted for the project Owner or as self-removal. Prohibits removing the last Owner.

put.description: Changes a project member's role. Prohibits demoting the project's last owner. Requires Owner role.

post.description: Adds a comment to a task. Any project member (Viewer, Editor, Owner) can comment on accessible tasks.

get.description: Retrieves chronological comments on a task. Requires Viewer role on the project.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a task comment. Allowed only for the comment author or project owners.

get.description: Returns identity and scope claims from the validated access token.
